# Trace-analysis dependency

These eleven `QuantumChannelStein` source modules supply finite quantum-state
and trace-norm analysis used by the lower bounds. Lake builds them as part of
this repository; no separate checkout is needed.

The files are unchanged from the inherited formalization snapshot. Exact hashes
and its original local provenance are recorded in [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json).
The preserved Apache-2.0 attribution for the adapted Physlib SVD proof is in
[TraceNorm.lean](QuantumChannelStein/TraceNorm.lean) and
[docs/Physlib-Apache-2.0.txt](docs/Physlib-Apache-2.0.txt).
